question: Is the 0/600 official Deep judge zero-hit a judge failure or a candidate-generation failure?
method: Deterministic string-overlap analysis of the frozen probe input (official_input.jsonl, sha256 below): exact, substring, and token-overlap recovery of each reference title from that item's candidate titles, judge-independent.
conclusion: Candidate generation is the failing stage. Even a judge-free perfect string matcher recovers only 8 of 564 references (0.0142) from the frozen candidate sets, with zero exact and zero substring matches; the judged 0/600 is consistent with candidates that almost never contain the reference. Re-scoring the frozen candidates cannot revive the probe; revival requires regenerating candidates with a corrected retrieval mechanism (needle questions whose surface lexicon echoes in wrong papers, e.g. 'supplementary' in the question retrieving a title containing 'Supplementary Orbit').
